description: This file defines the OrderStatusHistory class, which models the historical status changes of an order within the sales management system. It includes fields for ID, associated order, status, timestamp, customer notification status, and comments. It also provides getter and setter methods for these fields.

classes.name: OrderStatusHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing an entry in the order status history log, including status changes, their timestamps, related order, and notification comments.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this order status history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this order status history record.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an Order object with this status history record.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the order.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the status was recorded, with cloning to prevent unintended modifications.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for when the status was recorded, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getCustomerNotified
methods.description: Returns whether the customer has been notified about the status change.

methods.name: setCustomerNotified
methods.description: Sets the notification status for the customer.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to the status change.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to the status change.
